sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gunsmith Master - Part 1 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Hello. There is a new order for a Western HK 416A5 rifle. Requires tan-colored attachments: SureFire SOCOM556-RC2 silencer, Magpul RVG tactical grip, EOTech EXPS3 holographic sight, Magpul MOE pistol grip, Magpul UBR GEN2 stock, LA-5B/PEQ tactical module, and a mag with at least 30 round capacity. Ergonomics over 50, recoil sum under 310, weight 4 kilos or lower. Just like in Special Forces, right? Oh, and try to find a rifle that isn't thrashed, technical condition must be at least 80%."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must be level 27 to start this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Modify an HK 416A5 to comply with the given specifications

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +14,900 EXP
- Mechanic Rep +0.02
- 500 Dollars
  - 525 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 575 Dollars with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 1× Torrey Pines Logic T12W 30Hz thermal reflex sight
- 3× Gunpowder "Eagle"
- Unlocks purchase of AR-15 Magpul PRS GEN3 stock (Black) at Peacekeeper LL3
"A real door kicker blaster! Thank you for the help, mercenary."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
HK 416A5 specifications:
- 80 Durability
- 50 or more ergonomics
- 310 or less recoil
- 4 kg or less in weight
- 300 or greater sighting range
- A magazine with a capacity of at least 30
- SureFire SOCOM556-RC2 5.56x45 sound suppressor
- Magpul RVG foregrip (FDE)
- EOTech EXPS3-0 holographic sight (Tan)
- AR-15 Magpul UBR GEN2 stock (FDE)
- AR-15 Magpul MOE pistol grip (FDE)
- L3Harris LA-5B/PEQ tactical device

sections.heading: Notes:
sections.text:
- This build is based on a standard black HK 416A5 from Peacekeeper LL3. It can only be purchased after completing Weapons Circulation.
- Make sure that the chamber is empty, otherwise the gun will be too heavy.
- The quest check mark is not consistent even when all requirements are met, it not being present doesn't mean the gun can't be handed over.
